# `stealth` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "stealth" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/stealth/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique table id; the game reads "stealth". |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, tuning status). |
| `visibility` | object | required | Visibility model weights (mw-e09.2). |
| `visibility.light` | object | required | Light term: the target’s light samples, combined, then lifted by the observer’s dark vision (seen = level + (1 − level) × darkVision, so dark vision 1 sees full light), read on the curve. |
| `visibility.light.curve` | list of object (at least 2) | required | Light term by seen light level: points in rising level order, from level 0 to level 1. |
| `visibility.light.curve[].level` | number 0–1 | required | Light level seen by the observer, 0–1 (after dark vision). |
| `visibility.light.curve[].term` | number 0–2 | required | Light term at that level, 0–2. |
| `visibility.light.peakWeight` | number 0–1 | required | How the target’s light samples combine, 0–1: 0 = their mean, 1 = the brightest; a lit head on a body in shadow still shows. |
| `visibility.stance` | object | required | Stance term per stance, 0–2. |
| `visibility.stance.prone` | number 0–2 | required | Lying flat. |
| `visibility.stance.crouched` | number 0–2 | required | Crouched. |
| `visibility.stance.standing` | number 0–2 | required | Standing (1 = neutral). |
| `visibility.motion` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Motion term by horizontal speed: bands in rising fromSpeed order; the fastest band the speed reaches applies. |
| `visibility.motion[].fromSpeed` | number 0–50 | required | Horizontal speed at which this band starts, m/s; the first band starts at 0. |
| `visibility.motion[].term` | number 0–2 | required | Motion term in this band, 0–2. |
| `visibility.profile` | object | required | Profile modifiers on top of the equipment brightness the target supplies (both multiply). |
| `visibility.profile.cloak` | number 0–2 | required | Multiplier while a cloak or other concealing garment is worn. |
| `visibility.profile.disguise` | number 0–2 | required | Multiplier while disguised. |
| `visibility.distance` | list of object (at least 2) | required | Distance falloff: points in rising distance order from 0 m, never rising; flat past the last. |
| `visibility.distance[].metres` | number 0–500 | required | Observer-to-target distance, m. |
| `visibility.distance[].term` | number 0–2 | required | Distance falloff at that distance, 0–2. |
| `visibility.contrast` | object | required | Contrast rule: a dark figure against bright background light stands out. |
| `visibility.contrast.backgroundThreshold` | number 0–1 | required | Background light at or above which a target is silhouetted against it, 0–1. |
| `visibility.contrast.darkTargetMax` | number 0–1 | required | The target counts as dark (a silhouette) when its own combined light is at or below this, 0–1. |
| `visibility.contrast.bonus` | number 0–2 | required | Added to a silhouetted target’s light term (capped at the full-light term), 0–2. |
